hypothesis: Stronger subcloud evaporation suppresses rainfall in dry air, improving monsoon seasonal contrast and over-wet dry interiors while preserving wet-air rainfall
pilot_requirements: Mean rainfall loss and monthly rainfall MAE must improve; mean temperature MAE must not worsen by more than 1%; no regional monthly rainfall MAE increase greater than max(2 mm, 10%); select at most one amplitude for all 31 development regions
development_gate: Unchanged policy_v2 rules, referenced to the restored r31 run: S improves by at least 0.5%, no group worsens, neither temperature MAE nor rainfall loss worsens by more than 1%
transfer: Only after the full development gate passes: paired 28 km California, western Europe, Japan and New Zealand; then the six established validation regions once for the selected milestone. These have been evaluated previously and are not fresh independent validation.
accounting: The existing humidity- and cloud-base-dependent precipitation efficiency is solved inside the vapor equation; evaporated precipitation remains in vapor rather than being subtracted from final rainfall after solving
publication: A pilot or benchmark gain alone does not update an atlas. Adopted Earth physics must be carried through map calibration and native atlas verification.
